verify.note: same sim as the published number (seed 1)

summary: Seal Fate Daggers against a Humanoid or Giant boss, with Murder 2/2 (+4% damage to Humanoids and Giants) taking the points the generic-boss build spends elsewhere.
advantage: Murder 2/2 makes every attack do 4% more damage to Humanoids and Giants. Against other bosses it does nothing, so the normal build spends those points elsewhere.
advantageShort: Murder 2/2: +4% damage to Humanoids and Giants. It does nothing elsewhere, so the normal build skips it.
rotation: Uses the Combat Daggers rotation (no Adrenaline Rush or Blade Flurry talents, so those lines are skipped)
Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh at 5 when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6 s left); spend leftover points in the last 3 s
Backstab right after a main-hand swing (0.25 s), or at 100 energy
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Murder is damage only (+4%) and only against Humanoids and Giants

Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Improved Sinister Strike 2 is a row-filler with no DPS effect
Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV) left out under Forever; would add +13 to +18
Grimstitch 4/5-piece bonuses not live on the synthetic gear (about +8 / +6 for Combat Daggers)
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir omitted for consistency (+8 via Dragonbreath Chili)
Best Alliance race is High Order; since client 70425 the races are within about 3 DPS of each other
notes: Request from mksettings with the same arguments as rogue__seal-fate-daggers except talents, then the target's mobType set to MobTypeHumanoid, as the class preset's encounter does.
